import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static Map<Integer, Integer>[] graph = new HashMap[7000];
    static char[][] grid = new char[20][20];
    static int size_n, size_m, total_nodes, target_map[][] = new int[10][10];
    static int[] parent = new int[7000], flow_value = new int[7000];
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7000; i++) {
            graph[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    static int max_flow(int start, int end, int capacity) {
        int total = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < 1; f++) {
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            parent[start] = start;
            flow_value[start] = capacity;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(start);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int node = q.poll();
                if (node == end) {
                    for (int cur = node; cur != start; cur = parent[cur]) {
                        int p = parent[cur];
                        graph[p].put(cur, graph[p].getOrDefault(cur, 0) - flow_value[end]);
                        graph[cur].put(p, graph[cur].getOrDefault(p, 0) + flow_value[end]);
                    }
                    total += flow_value[end];
                    break;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> it : graph[node].entrySet()) {
                    int neighbor = it.getKey();
                    int capacityEdge = it.getValue();
                    if (capacityEdge >= capacity && parent[neighbor] == -1) {
                        parent[neighbor] = node;
                        flow_value[neighbor] = Math.min(capacityEdge, flow_value[node]);
                        q.offer(neighbor);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int encode_node(int x, int y, int t) {
        return x + y * size_n + t * size_n * size_n + 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        size_n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        size_m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int total_res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < size_n; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    graph[0].put(encode_node(i, j, 0), grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < size_n; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(target_map[i], size_m + 1);
        }

        Queue<int[]> q_bfs = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = size_n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = size_n - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    target_map[i][j] = 0;
                    q_bfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                } else {
                    target_map[i][j] = size_m + 1;
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q_bfs.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q_bfs.poll();
            int i = p[0], j = p[1];
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int t = target_map[i][j];
                int x = i + dx[dir], y = j + dy[dir];
                if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < size_n && y < size_n && grid[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < target_map[x][y]) {
                    target_map[x][y] = t + 1;
                    q_bfs.offer(new int[]{x, y});
                }
            }
        }

        total_nodes = encode_node(size_n - 1, size_n - 1, size_m) + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size_n; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < size_m; t++) {
                    if (t < size_m) {
                        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
                            int x = i + dx[q], y = j + dy[q];
                            if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < size_n && y < size_n && grid[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < target_map[x][y] + (grid[x][y] > '0' && grid[x][y] <= '9' ? 1 : 0) && t < target_map[i][j]) {
                                graph[encode_node(i, j, t)].put(encode_node(x, y, t + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                            graph[encode_node(i, j, t)].put(encode_node(i, j, size_m), grid[i][j] - '0');
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    graph[encode_node(i, j, size_m)].put(1, grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 8; u > 0; u /= 2) {
            total_res += max_flow(0, 1, u);
        }
        System.out.println(total_res);
    }
}
